Frequently Asked Questions

          

            

              
Which government portals are included?

              
You get 24/7 monitoring across all 52 procurement portals nationwide: Federal (SAM.gov & SBIR.gov), National Municipal (DemandStar), and all 50 State SLED portals—Virginia (eVA & VITA), Texas (SmartBuy ESBD & DIR), California (Cal eProcure & CDT), Florida (MFMP VIP & FLDS), Maryland (eMMA & DoIT), Illinois (BidBuy & DoIT/CTA), Pennsylvania (DGS eMarketplace & OA-OIT), Ohio (OhioBuys & DAS), Georgia (DOAS GPR & GTA), North Carolina (NC eVP & NCDIT), New York (NYC CROL, PASSPort & PANYNJ), Massachusetts (COMMBUYS, EOTSS & MBTA), New Jersey (NJSTART, Treasury DPP & NJOIT), Washington (WEBS & WaTech DES), Michigan (SIGMA VSS & DTMB), Colorado (VSS & OIT), Arizona (APP Procure.AZ.gov & ADOA-ASET), Minnesota (SWIFT & MNIT), Tennessee (Edison CPO & STS), Indiana (IDOA & IOT), Missouri (MissouriBUYS & OA-ITSD), Wisconsin (eSupplier, VendorNet & DET), South Carolina (SCBO & SFAA), Oregon (OregonBuys & DAS EIS), Connecticut (CTsource & DAS BITS), Utah (U3P SciQuest & DTS), Nevada (NevadaEPro & EITS), Alabama (Alabama Buys STAARS & OIT), Louisiana (LaPAC/LaGov & OTS), Kentucky (KY VSS & COT), Oklahoma (OMES & Information Services), Iowa (IMPACS & DOM DoIT), Kansas (SMART & OITS), Arkansas (ARBuy & DIS), Mississippi (MAGIC & ITS), New Mexico (GSD & DoIT), Nebraska (DAS Materiel & OCIO), Idaho (IPRO LUMA & ITS), Hawaii (HIePRO & ETS), New Hampshire (DAS BPP & DoIT), Maine (DAFS & MaineIT), Rhode Island (OSP & ETSS), Montana (eMACS & SITSD), Delaware (MyMarketplace & DTI), South Dakota (OPM & BIT), North Dakota (SPO & NDIT), Alaska (IRIS VSS & OIT), Vermont (BGS & ADS), West Virginia (wvOASIS & WVOT), and Wyoming (A&I & ETS).

            

            

              
Can I receive alerts in Slack, Microsoft Teams, CRM, or Email?

              
Yes—Slack, Microsoft Teams, CRM Webhooks (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier, Make, n8n), and 6-Hour Executive Email Briefings are our primary B2B delivery channels (with private Discord access also included). Tier 1 receives the 52-Portal Live RFP Alert Wire, while Tier 2 receives a unified dispatch combining Section I (25-API CaptureDesk Executive Dossiers) and Section II (Complete 52-Portal Live RFP Wire).

            

            

              
Do I receive a corporate tax invoice?

              
Yes. Every payment automatically generates an itemized B2B PDF invoice and receipt suitable for corporate expense cards and government contractor accounting.

            

            

              
Can I cancel or switch plans anytime?

              
Yes. There are no long-term lock-ins. You can manage, upgrade, or cancel your subscription in one click at any time.

            

            

              
What does Tier 3 Proposal Autopilot ($1,499/mo) compile?

              
Tier 3 chains our Shipley compliance, technical narrative, LCAT resume, Section B CLIN pricing, IGCE wrap-rate, CPARS, 13 CFR § 125.6 workshare, and FAR 9.5 OCI engines into a single 90-second download (.ZIP) containing editable Word (Volume_I_Technical_and_Management_Proposal.docx, Volume_III_Past_Performance_Compliance.docx) and live-formula Excel (Volume_II_Cost_Price_Model.xlsx) files.

            

            

              
What is included in Tier 4 Enterprise OEM ($2,499/mo)?

              
Tier 4 includes everything in Tier 3 plus 50,000 production REST & MCP tool calls/month across all SignalTender microservices, commercial OEM embedding rights for internal Copilot/Claude stacks, and full access to the Post-Award FOIA / State PIA Winning-Bid Rate Vault (GET /v1/proposal-autopilot/foia-winning-bid-vault).

ZERO-RETENTION AI

              
Stateless In-Memory Processing

              

                Documents, RFPs, capability statements, resumes, and security questionnaires sent to our 58 REST/MCP endpoints are processed in volatile memory over TLS 1.3, never written to disk, and never used to train AI models.
              

            

            

              
DATABASE & AUTH SECURITY

              
PostgreSQL RLS & PBKDF2-SHA256

              

                All persistence tables enforce strict PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) with zero public anonymous read/write exposure. Client passwords use salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (200,000 iterations).
              

            

            

              
PCI-DSS LEVEL 1 BILLING

              
Stripe Hosted Checkout & ACH

              

                SignalTender never touches, stores, or processes raw credit card or bank account numbers. All B2B subscriptions are handled directly by Stripe (PCI-DSS Level 1 Certified) with cryptographic webhook signature verification.
              

            

          


          

            
GovCon CUI, ITAR & Regulatory Compliance Posture

            

              

                
Public RFPs vs. Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)

                

                  All Federal (SAM.gov) and State SLED solicitations indexed by SignalTender are publicly released government procurement notices. When using our interactive APIs (`#01`–`#58`) for internal proposal drafting, capture teams should redact classified appendices, ITAR/EAR export-controlled technical drawings, or FOUO/CUI markings requiring FedRAMP High / IL5 enclaves prior to API transmission.
                

              

              

                
WAF Input Hardening & RFC 9116 Vulnerability Disclosure

                

                  All public forms and API routes enforce strict Pydantic V2 schema validation, sliding-window per-IP rate limiting, honeypot bot traps, HTML/XSS/SQLi payload rejection, and `SUPPRESS_EMBEDS` webhook sanitization. Security researchers may review our RFC 9116 disclosure policy at /.well-known/security.txt or submit findings via our hardened security form.

                  SignalTender is engineered as a 100% self-serve SaaS & API platform so you never have to wait 24–48 hours for a human support email to manage your subscription, webhooks, or API keys.

LEGAL GOVERNANCE // MASTER SAAS & API AGREEMENT

              
SignalTender Terms of Service & Acceptable Use Policy

            

            Effective Date: October 2026
          


          

            

              
1. Scope of Services & B2B Subscription Tiers

              

                SignalTender ("SignalTender", operated at signaltender.net) provides automated government procurement monitoring across 52 Federal, Municipal, and State SLED portals, pre-shredded AI capture dossiers, 1-click 3-volume Shipley proposal compilation, statutory FOIA/PIA award rate benchmarking, and 58 stateless REST/MCP microservices. Access is offered via: (a) Free Explorer Account (`$0/mo`), (b) Tier 1 SignalWire Pro (`$99/mo` or `$990/yr`), (c) Tier 2 CaptureDesk Autopilot (`$399/mo` or `$3,490/yr`), (d) Tier 3 Proposal Autopilot Enterprise (`$1,499/mo` or `$14,900/yr`), (e) Tier 4 Enterprise OEM & FOIA Winning-Bid Vault (`$2,499/mo` or `$24,900/yr`), and (f) individual API quotas hosted on RapidAPI Hub.
              

            


            

              
2. Self-Serve Billing, Automatic Renewal & 1-Click Cancellation

              

                Paid subscriptions are billed in advance on a monthly or annual cycle via Stripe Checkout (supporting corporate cards and US Bank ACH). You may cancel your subscription at any time in 1 click inside the Client Account Portal (#account) without contacting support. Upon cancellation, future recurring charges stop immediately and your workspace reverts smoothly to the Free Explorer tier.
              

            


            

              
3. GovCon AI Decision-Support & Regulatory Advisory Disclaimer

              

                SignalTender's AI outputs — including Shipley Section L/M Compliance Matrices, Contract Risk Redlines, FAR/DFARS/CMMC Clause Audits, IGCE Price-to-Win (PTW) Models, 13 CFR § 125.6 Subcontracting Calculations, RMF/cATO SSP Narratives, FAR 15.506 Debriefing / GAO Bid-Protest Analyses, and GSA MAS SIN Mappings — are automated capture decision-support tools. They do not constitute formal legal counsel, certified public accounting, or binding Contracting Officer determinations. Subscribers remain solely responsible for verifying final solicitation terms, SF-30 amendments, and pricing schedules on the official government issuing portal prior to bid submission.
              

            


            

              
4. Acceptable Use, Rate Limits & API Security

              

                Subscribers may not: (a) attempt to bypass rate limits, WAF filters, or authentication headers (X-RapidAPI-Key or X-SignalTender-Key); (b) transmit malicious scripts, XSS/SQLi payloads, or classified national security information; or (c) resell raw SignalTender API keys to unverified third parties without an active enterprise agreement.
              

            


            

              
5. Service Level Agreement (99.95% Uptime Target) & Limitation of Liability

              

                SignalTender maintains a 99.95% rolling 90-day uptime target across its FastAPI Gateway and 6-hour portal monitors, excluding upstream government portal maintenance outages (e.g., SAM.gov or state portal downtime). To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, SignalTender's aggregate liability under these Terms shall not exceed the total subscription fees paid by Customer during the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
              

            

          

        


        
        

          

            

              
DATA PROTECTION // PRIVACY POLICY & ZERO-RETENTION DPA

              
SignalTender Privacy Policy & Data Processing Addendum

            

            GDPR • CCPA • B2B DPA Aligned
          


          

            

              
1. Zero-Data-Retention API & Document Processing Guarantee

              

                When you submit contract text, RFPs, capability statements, resumes, CLIN tables, or security questionnaires to SignalTender's 58 APIs or Studio Playground, payloads are processed statelessly in volatile memory solely to return your structured JSON response. SignalTender never stores your uploaded proposal documents and never uses customer payloads to train or fine-tune foundation AI models.
              

            


            

              
2. Information We Collect for Account & Alert Delivery

              

                We collect only the minimal business contact metadata required to provision your account and route your alerts: work email address, organization name, salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hash, optional Discord handle or Slack/Teams/CRM webhook URL, and optional Company Capture Vault preferences (NAICS codes, set-aside flags, and wrap-rate assumptions stored in your account or browser `localStorage`).
              

            


            

              
3. Verified Infrastructure Sub-Processors

              

                

                  
Zero-Retention AI Inference Gateway

                  
Zero-retention commercial API inference (no model training on API inputs).

                

                

                  
Stripe, Inc.

                  
PCI-DSS Level 1 payment & US Bank ACH subscription processing.

                

                

                  
Supabase (AWS US-East)

                  
RLS-protected PostgreSQL storage for public RFP metadata & account prefs.

                

                

                  
Render & Cloudflare

                  
TLS 1.3 edge termination, DDoS mitigation & container hosting.

                

                

                  
RapidAPI Hub

                  
Optional developer API key gateway & per-request quota metering.

                

                

                  
Resend / SMTP

                  
Transactional 6-hour executive RFP email briefings with 1-click unsubscribe.

                

              

            


            

              
4. Cookies, Local Storage & Data Deletion Rights

              

                SignalTender does not use invasive third-party advertising trackers. We use standard browser `localStorage` and `sessionStorage` strictly to maintain your authenticated session token and saved Studio Playground preferences. You may clear your vault, pause all alerts, or cancel your account at any time inside #account.
